mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month relative to the previous 6-month average, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo vs 6mo avg
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced residential investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth accelerates by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strengthening manufacturing sector and potential economic overheating, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) growth slows by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter, and the unemployment rate is above 7%, it signals a weakening consumer sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth slows by > 1% QoQ and UNRATE > 7%
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% year-over-year, and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary overheating and likelihood of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
